# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Barbarian level 1 low-Constitution edge-case fixture.
# Identical to the accepted Human Barbarian level 1 deterministic chassis baseline
# fixture except for a deliberately low Constitution score (1, modifier -5). It
# exists solely to exercise the rage-rounds-per-day claim-blocking guard in
# `explain_barbarian_level1_chassis`: 4 + Constitution modifier is non-positive at
# this score (4 + -5 = -1), which has no PF1 Core Rulebook meaning as a "rounds per
# day" count, so the compute seam must claim-block that record rather than assert a
# fabricated negative value. It names selections only; it does not contain derived,
# computed, or parity values.
